# Orb's fonts and icons. fonts/, pack/ and the src/orb_fonts_*.c tables are generated by
# scripts/fonts.sh (tools/fonts); see README.md.
# port/: the font pack's flash, inflate and PSRAM hooks on the device (the host check has its own).
idf_component_register(SRC_DIRS "src" "fonts" "port"
                       INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
                       PRIV_INCLUDE_DIRS "src"
                       REQUIRES esp_common lvgl
                       PRIV_REQUIRES esp_timer esp_partition esp_rom esp_hw_support heap log bootloader_support mbedtls freertos orb_memory orb_fs)

# Keep cold loading/settings code below the next 64 KiB XIP page: crossing it
# would spend the switch's PSRAM reserve on mirrored instructions. Lifetime
# handle callbacks and LVGL decoders retain the normal optimization setting.
set_source_files_properties(src/orb_fonts.c src/orb_fonts_pack.c
                            PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Os")

# Build artifacts deliberately contain an unsigned *pack*, never a flashable assets
# image. scripts/sign-assets.sh wraps/signs it with the running app's release key.
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION)
    # configure_file tracks the pack input and reconfigures when it changes.
    idf_build_get_property(orb_build_dir BUILD_DIR)
    set(pack "${orb_build_dir}/orb_fonts.pack")
    configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/pack/orb_fonts.pack" "${pack}" COPYONLY)
    set(sound_pack "${orb_build_dir}/orb_sounds.orbs")
    configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../tools/sounds/out/palette.orbs"
                   "${sound_pack}" COPYONLY)
    partition_table_get_partition_info(part_offset "--partition-name ${CONFIG_ORB_FONTS_PACK_PARTITION}" "offset")
    partition_table_get_partition_info(part_size "--partition-name ${CONFIG_ORB_FONTS_PACK_PARTITION}" "size")
    if(part_offset AND part_size)
        file(SIZE "${pack}" pack_size)
        file(SIZE "${sound_pack}" sound_size)
        math(EXPR signed_size "(64 + 32 + ${pack_size} + 3 + ${sound_size} + 4095) / 4096 * 4096 + 4096")
        if(signed_size GREATER part_size)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "orb_fonts: the font/sound pack (${pack_size} + ${sound_size} B) doesn't fit in "
                                "${CONFIG_ORB_FONTS_PACK_PARTITION} with its signed header")
        endif()
    else()
        message(WARNING "orb_fonts: no \"${CONFIG_ORB_FONTS_PACK_PARTITION}\" partition: "
                        "only built-in rescue typography will be available")
    endif()
endif()
